verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a Managed Postgres offering described as a fully-managed service that handles all aspects of running production PostgreSQL [fly-io-docs-19], so the core 'managed Postgres' part is evidenced. Nothing in the pack covers point-in-time recovery, replicas or high availability. Community reports of Postgres machines going down during a host outage [fly-io-comm-2, fly-io-comm-4] cast doubt on availability, but they predate and don't clearly concern the managed offering, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented point-in-time recovery, read replicas, HA/automatic failover, and independent hands-on corroboration of the managed service.
